sql: SELECT T2.skill, COUNT(T1.posting_key) AS num_listings FROM fct_posting AS T1 INNER JOIN posting_skills AS T2 ON T1.posting_key = T2.posting_key WHERE T1.is_open AND T1.remote_us AND T1.is_canonical_listing GROUP BY T2.skill ORDER BY num_listings DESC LIMIT 10
